what: #150 WP-C (B8, D-106(f)): THE ONE record of which Supabase projects PINTAR's workflows point at, and of the sign-in and email settings each project must carry. Every workflow's project reference, address and public key, and every literal of the settings below, must equal this record: scripts/recovery/repoint.mjs check fails on any difference (selftest DR-S12). Moving an environment to another project (after a native restore to a new project, RUNBOOK-NATIVE-RESTORE.md step 3) is done only by `repoint.mjs apply`, which rewrites this record and every workflow together, refuses a malformed or reused reference and requires the decision that authorised it; the move is a reviewed commit, never a hidden setting. `repoint.mjs verify` checks the live project's name, region and health against this record before anything is written to it. Public values only: no password, token or service key is ever kept here.
